# Éclat Institute — 100% Online Virtual Campus
> Official Canonical Knowledge Document for Search Engines, AI Overviews, and Knowledge Graphs.

> Institution Type: 100% Online Virtual Campus & Higher Learning Institution

## About Éclat Institute
Éclat Institute (https://eclat.institute) is a premier 100% Online Virtual Campus and Virtual Learning Management Platform. It delivers live interactive cohorts, hands-on virtual laboratory training, industry mentorship, and cryptographically verified digital certificates to students and professionals across the globe.

Éclat Institute operates EXCLUSIVELY ONLINE globally and has no physical classrooms or connection to any Singapore O-Level/A-Level science tuition centers. All classes are conducted via live virtual video classrooms with interactive screen sharing, breakout rooms, and LMS portal access.

## Academic Faculties & Curriculum
1. **School of Business**:
   - Professional Forex Trading, Currency Markets & Technical Analysis (FX Mastery)
   - Algorithmic Forex Trading & Quantitative Bot Strategies (Python & MT5)
   - Executive Project Management Professional (PMP®) & Agile Leadership (PMBOK 7 & Scrum)
   - Financial Modeling & Valuation Analyst (FMVA®) & Investment Banking (DCF & LBO)
   - Strategic Corporate FP&A & Management Accounting (CMA® Track)
   - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (LSSGB®) & Process Optimization (DMAIC & SPC)
   - Enterprise Business Analysis & Digital Transformation (CBAP® & PMI-PBA®)
   - Global Supply Chain Strategy, Logistics & Procurement (CSCP® & APICS)
   - Strategic HR Leadership, Talent Acquisition & People Analytics (SHRM-CP®)
   - Digital Marketing Strategy, Performance Growth & MarTech Leadership
   - Computerized Accounting with QuickBooks Pro, Payroll & International Tax / iTax

2. **School of IT and Data Science**:
   - Full-Stack Web Engineering (React 19, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js Express APIs, PostgreSQL)
   - Advanced Data Science & Machine Learning with Python & Pandas
   - Biostatistics & Statistical Computing with R & RStudio
   - Survey Data Analysis with IBM SPSS Statistics & Econometric Time-Series with Stata
   - UI/UX Product Design & Mobile Design Systems (Figma, Wireframing, Prototypes)
   - Enterprise Cybersecurity Operations & Ethical Hacking

3. **School of Language**:
   - IELTS Academic & General Training Exam Coaching (Band 7.5 – 9.0 Preparation)
   - German Language Mastery (Goethe-Zertifikat A1–B2)
   - French Language & Francophone Communication (DELF A1–B2)
   - Modern Standard Arabic (Conversational & Professional)
   - Swahili for International Researchers & Diplomats

4. **IGCSE (British International Curriculum)**:
   - Accredited Examination Centres: **Cambridge Assessment International Education (CAIE Center KE042)** and **Pearson Edexcel (Center EDX-98421)**
   - Complete curricula across **Years 9, 10, and 11**
   - Core & Extended syllabuses in Mathematics (0580 / 4MA1), Physics (0625 / 4PH1), Chemistry (0620 / 4CH1), Biology (0610 / 4BI1), Computer Science (0478 / 4CP0), First Language English (0500 / 4EA1), Business Studies (0450 / 4BS1), and Economics (0455 / 4EC1)
   - Official statement of results, past paper marathons, and Alternative to Practical (ATP) laboratory series

## Key Features & Student Benefits
- **Schedule**: Live Evening Cohorts (6:00 PM – 9:30 PM) and Weekend Intensive Masterclasses.
- **Accreditation & Certification**: Every graduate receives a verified digital certificate featuring instant QR verification for LinkedIn, employers, and higher education.
- **Tuition & Financing**: Affordable global pricing in US Dollars ($ USD) with flexible 2-part and 3-part monthly installment plans (50% deposit to start).
- **Learning Management System**: 24/7 access to recorded live sessions, downloadable lecture slides, interactive DRM e-library, and coding datasets.
